tool_args.rationale: The observed base-field, sink-gradient, and coupled-lag signatures match the archived spatiotemporal siphon-memory mechanism. The trajectory batch supplies the additional observations needed to identify and test its five parameters.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the spatiotemporal siphon-memory ODE immediately
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five observations are insufficient to reliably identify its five coupled parameters; the archive specifies at least eight rows.

considered_alternatives.option: Static siphon or uncoupled memory model
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot signatures indicate both sink-gradient effects and coupled transient lag, making the combined ODE a better candidate.
It does not resolve the relevant parameter-identification ambiguity.
